transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I'm not going to the toilet like I should.
When did you first notice this change?
About three weeks ago.
Do you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
No, none that I know of.
How much is this affecting your day-to-day life?
The straining is uncomfortable — about four out of ten.
Can you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have started recently, and any health problems, operations, or hospital stays you’ve had in the past?
I started some co-codamol about a month ago, for my back.
Have you had any other symptoms along with the straining?
My lower tummy feels bloated.
Have you ever had any operations or stays in hospital?
No, I've never had an operation.
Aside from the co-codamol you started for your back, are you taking any other medicines at all, including ones from the doctor, a shop, or a pharmacy?
I take apixaban, twice a day.
Have you noticed anything that makes it easier or harder for you to go to the toilet?
I've been drinking less tea, so I don't get up at night.
Does this happen every day, or does it come and go?
Now it's about every four or five days.
When you say you're not going to the toilet like you should, is it that you're going less often than you used to, that you're going less often than you'd like, or you're not sure?
Less often than I used to.

Besides the co-codamol and apixaban, are there any other medicines you take at any time of day — such as inhalers, eye drops, creams, injections or patches, or anything you buy without a prescription like painkillers, vitamins or herbal remedies?
My son's wife sorts all my tablets out for me.
Since this started, have you noticed any other changes, like in your appetite, sleep, weight or energy?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that.
What worries you most about going to the toilet less often than you used to?
I worry it could be something serious, like cancer.
Are there any health conditions you see a doctor or nurse about regularly, or is there nothing like that?
I've got osteoarthritis in my knees.
Besides the bloated lower tummy, have you noticed any changes in how often you pee or poo, or in your breathing, since this started?
No, nothing like that.
Besides your knees, your back, and the apixaban you take, are there any other health problems you take medicines for that we haven’t talked about, or is that everything?
I've got an irregular heartbeat.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
